name: Tongue
overview: Scripture reveals that the diversity of human languages and tongues originated from God's sovereign design, as seen in Genesis 10 where nations and families are distinguished by their tongues. The account in Genesis 11 illustrates the original unity of language before God confused the tongues at Babel, leading to the scattering of people across the earth. This emphasizes both the power and significance of the tongue in human identity and communication, highlighting the need for wisdom and restraint in its use.
